name: library
title: Open-source library
summary: Your users get a changelog line and the right version bump, every release.

rules.text: A breaking change bumps the major version.
rules.why: people pin a major version, so a breaking change must never arrive inside one.

rules.text: Every public function has a working example in the docs.
rules.why: an example that runs teaches a function fastest and breaks loudly when the function changes.
